description_for_model: AYA is a public index of organizations rated for AI readability. Use this tool to look up companies, check their AI-readability score (AIO, 0-100), and retrieve structured data about them. The AIO score measures how well a website's structured data can be understood by AI systems. Higher scores mean AI agents can more reliably recommend and describe the entity. Use aya_search when a user asks about a company. Use aya_entities to compare or filter companies. Use aya_entity for detailed info. Use aya_stats for index-wide context.
description_for_human: Search the AYA index of companies rated for AI readability (AIO score 0-100).

function.name: aya_search
function.description: Search the AYA index by company name, domain, description, or country. Returns matching entities sorted by AIO score. Use this when a user mentions a company and you want to check if it is in the AYA index.

query.description: Search term: company name, domain (e.g. 'adobe.com'), or country name. Case-insensitive, partial match.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-200). Default: 50.

function.name: aya_entities
function.description: Browse all indexed entities with optional filters (sector, country, minimum score, JSON-LD presence) and pagination. Use this to compare companies, find top-rated entities in a sector, or list companies by country.

sort.description: Sort order. 'score' = highest AIO score first (default), 'name' = alphabetical, 'domain' = by domain name.

min_score.description: Only return entities with AIO score >= this value (0-100).

sector.description: Filter by sector_id. Values: tech_saas, finance, health, food_bev, retail, education, energy, consulting, media, transport, industrial, real_estate, telecom, government, nonprofit, unknown.

country.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'CH', 'US', 'FR', 'DE').

has_jsonld.description: Filter by JSON-LD structured data presence on the website.

function.name: aya_entity
function.description: Get the full AYA record for a specific entity by its canonical domain. Returns complete data including all 7 AIO block scores, entity details, sector, structured data analysis, and ASR_DERIVED record. Use this when you need detailed information about one specific company.

domain.description: Canonical domain of the entity (e.g. 'adobe.com', 'nestle.com'). Do not include 'www.' or 'https://'.

function.name: aya_asr
function.description: Get the ASR_DERIVED (AI Singular Record) for a specific entity. This is the structured identity data subset optimized for AI consumption: entity info, AIO block analysis, scoring breakdown, and readiness assessment. Use this when you want the richest structured data about a company for AI reasoning.

domain.description: Canonical domain of the entity (e.g. 'adobe.com'). Do not include 'www.' or 'https://'.

function.name: aya_stats
function.description: Get aggregate statistics about the entire AYA index: total entities, average/min/max AIO scores, percentage with JSON-LD and sitemaps, breakdown by sector and country. Use this to provide context about the index or when comparing a specific entity's score to the average.
